evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/bill/bill.controller.ts:14-29 protects GET /api/v1/bills with JwtAuthGuard and passes only request.user.userId to BillService
finalsource/be/src/modules/bill/bill.service.ts:14-17 scopes the repository lookup by the supplied authenticated userId
finalsource/be/src/modules/auth/jwt-auth.guard.ts:14-31 accepts only a verified Bearer JWT identity and assigns its parsed subject as request.user.userId
requirements.rationale: The inspectable endpoint and query use the validated request identity and expose no client-controlled user identifier; the separate application-startup defect prevents runtime observation but does not remove the source-level ownership scope.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/bill/bill.service.ts:14-17 queries all bills matching userId and supplies no dueDate predicate
No current-date boundary or upper calendar-window bound appears in BillService
requirements.rationale: Owned overdue bills and owned bills beyond the required near-term window can be returned.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/bill/bill.service.ts:14-17 applies only the userId repository condition
finalsource/be/src/modules/bill/bill.service.ts:35-37 maps lastChargeDate but never compares it with dueDate
requirements.rationale: A bill whose last charge is equal to or later than its due date is not excluded.

finalsource/fe/src/pages/Bills/Bills.tsx:72-76 stores the server array without applying any ordering
requirements.rationale: The implementation does not enforce due-date, amount, or bill-ID ordering.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/bill/bill.service.ts:29-39 maps DTO fields and normalizes absent nullable values
finalsource/be/src/modules/bill/bill.service.ts:32 returns itemDescription without trimming

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/bill/bill.service.ts:16 returns every owned bill rather than all and only eligible bills
